- The likely fix is to move config-file classification/loading into `src/config/parser.rs` and tighten the validated shape so operator config is always present once a config file is accepted.
- Next: verify call sites and patch the parser plus CLI module accordingly, then add/update tests around the new boundary.

- Read Ralph progress, refreshed task summaries, and inspected the choose-task rules plus both active smell task files.
- Confirmed there are exactly two active unblocked failing non-bug tasks: `.ralph/tasks/smells/dcs-bootstrap-removal-and-worker-collapse.md` and `.ralph/tasks/smells/ha-flat-observation-and-decision-collapse.md`; no current task pointer file exists.
- Checked a small amount of code context: the HA smell still spans `src/ha/types.rs`, `src/ha/worker.rs`, `src/ha/decide.rs`, `src/ha/reconcile.rs`, and `src/ha/state.rs`, while the DCS smell is more localized in `src/dcs`; next step is to choose the higher-leverage failing task and write its path to `.ralph/current_task.txt`, then quit immediately.

- Selected the next task and wrote `.ralph/current_task.txt`.
- Chose `.ralph/tasks/smells/dcs-bootstrap-removal-and-worker-collapse.md` because both active tasks are unblocked failing non-bug tasks, neither has a higher visible priority tag, and the DCS smell is the narrower/higher-leverage boundary cleanup before the broader HA flattening.
- Next agent should start that DCS smell task immediately and quit task-selection flow.

- Next: read the task markdown, determine whether it is a design pass or execution pass, then either refine types/plan or implement.

- Read the active DCS smell task and confirmed it targets a large boundary reduction in `src/dcs`: remove `startup.rs`, collapse worker helpers, and merge duplicated key logic.
- The task file is longer, so I still need to inspect the remainder for the current plan marker (`TO BE VERIFIED` vs `NOW EXECUTE`) and any existing implementation notes.
- Next: read the rest of the task file, then inspect the relevant `src/dcs` modules before deciding whether to design or execute.

- Read `src/dcs/startup.rs`, `src/dcs/state.rs`, `src/dcs/mod.rs`, `src/runtime/node.rs`, and the first large part of `src/dcs/worker.rs` to understand the current DCS composition and helper sprawl.
- Next: finish reading the worker, derive the smallest coherent type/ownership redesign, update the task plan to end with `NOW EXECUTE`, and then stop.

- Finished reading `src/dcs/worker.rs`; the code matches the task exactly: one actor loop with many one-caller helpers, duplicated key parsing/rendering, and a removable startup/bootstrap courier.
- I also checked `src/dcs/command.rs` and `src/dcs/log_event.rs` so the redesign can account for command/control and the current stage-split log events.
- Next: read the specific smell guidance files (3, 10, 5, 1), then write a concrete `NOW EXECUTE` plan into the task file and stop.

- Treated this turn as the required design pass because `.ralph/tasks/smells/dcs-bootstrap-removal-and-worker-collapse.md` had no `NOW EXECUTE` / `TO BE VERIFIED` marker.
- Read the active task plus `src/dcs/{mod,startup,state,worker,command,log_event}.rs`, `src/runtime/node.rs`, and the relevant improve-code-boundaries smell guides (3, 10, 5, 1).
- Updated the task file to `<status>in_progress</status>` and added a concrete `<plan>` ending in `NOW EXECUTE`.
- The plan is: delete `src/dcs/startup.rs`, stop runtime from assembling DCS internals, replace the broad `DcsRuntimeCtx` courier with a flatter actor-owned shape, introduce one typed DCS key artifact for parse/render/apply/write, collapse worker helpers into one actor loop plus one real session artifact, and then run `make check`, `make lint`, `make test`, `make test-long` during execution.
- I did not start implementation or run checks because the workflow explicitly says to stop immediately after converting the task into a `NOW EXECUTE` plan.
- Next agent should execute the plan from the task file, beginning with the boundary move and type flattening before fixing compiler fallout.

- Read Ralph progress and confirmed the current task points to `.ralph/tasks/smells/dcs-bootstrap-removal-and-worker-collapse.md`.
- Starting the execution pass by loading the task markdown and the `improve-code-boundaries` skill instructions.
- Next: read the plan marker in the task file, inspect the affected DCS/runtime modules, and then patch the boundary/types before running checks.

- Loaded the active smell task and confirmed it is in `NOW EXECUTE` mode, so this turn must implement the written plan.
- Read the current `src/dcs/{mod,state,worker}.rs` and `src/runtime/node.rs`; the old startup/bootstrap corridor is still present and unchanged.
- Next: finish reading `src/dcs/worker.rs` and `src/dcs/startup.rs`, then patch the DCS-owned composition boundary before collapsing worker helpers.

- Finished reading the full DCS worker/startup/runtime code and the surrounding state types.
- Chosen implementation shape: delete `src/dcs/startup.rs`, move composition into `src/dcs/mod.rs`, replace `DcsRuntimeCtx` with an actor-owned `DcsWorker`, add one scope-owned DCS key artifact plus one small etcd utility artifact, and fold the stage-specific failure mapping behind a single phase enum.
- Next: patch `src/dcs/{mod,state,worker}.rs`, `src/runtime/node.rs`, delete `src/dcs/startup.rs`, then compile/test the fallout.

- Applied the main boundary rewrite: `src/dcs/startup.rs` deleted, `src/dcs/mod.rs` now owns DCS bootstrap, `src/runtime/node.rs` now consumes direct DCS artifacts, and `src/dcs/worker.rs` was rebuilt around `DcsWorker`, `DcsKeySpace`, and `EtcdRuntime`.
- `src/dcs/state.rs` no longer carries the broad `DcsRuntimeCtx` courier.
- Next: format, run `make check`, fix compiler/lint fallout, then continue through the required test gates.

- `make check` failed on clippy, specifically `expect_used` on the new session invariant and `large_enum_variant` on `DcsChange`.
- Patched the worker to return typed `WorkerError` instead of panicking on missing session state, and boxed the large member variant in the key-change enum.
- Next: reformat and rerun `make check`, then continue to `make lint`, `make test`, and `make test-long` if green.

- All required gates are now green: `make check`, `make lint`, `make test`, and `make test-long`.
- `make test` passed 244/244 tests (with 5 known leaky tests reported by nextest) and `make test-long` passed 16/16 long HA scenarios.
- Next: mark the task file complete, run `.ralph/task_switch.sh`, commit all changes including `.ralph`, and push.
